description:
Hyde Park luxury living with panoramic Harbour & City Views

Auction Location: On-Site

This 239sqm penthouse-quality masterpiece occupies a high-floor northwest corner position in 'The Residence' on Hyde Park. A home of impressive size and quality, the apartment on level sixteen is elevated above the city and immersed within it to provide a lifestyle of privilege and prestige with an iconic outlook.

– Tightly-held opportunity in one of Sydney's most celebrated buildings
– Panoramic views include City, Harbour, Opera House, Domain, Hyde Park
– World-class amenities, pool, spa, gym, residents' lounge and boardroom
– Generous open living and dining framed in floor-to-ceiling windows
– Chef's kitchen equipped with high end European appliances and island
– Wraparound undercover balcony offers multiple entertainment zones
– Two ensuited bedrooms + versatile study/third bedroom also with ensuite
– Level 16 with direct balcony access from all living areas and every bedroom
– Ducted air-conditioning, gas fireplace, heated flooring, wine store and parking
– Access to private temperature controlled wine cellar storage on level four
– 24hr premium concierge service, dual lift access, iconic aspect and position


Apartment 239 sqm
Parking & Storage 35 sqm
Total 274 sqm

Strata $9,151pq approx.
Water $209 pq approx.
Council $617 pq approx.
